verdict.rationale: Cursor documents Automations: scheduled or event-triggered cloud agents created via the Agents Window, cursor.com/automations, the /automate skill, or Marketplace templates. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those automation definitions. The nearest items are skills described as "version-controlled packages" and project-level hooks.json/rules files that a user could keep in git. These are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
